lanes.name: IMAGE_DECODE
lanes.notes: Searcher-owned decode via Pillow. Donor inspect path unused (visionmcp not importable).

lanes.name: OBJECT_SEGMENTATION
lanes.notes: ocular.segment deferred (classical GrabCut, not product parts). Searcher cheap silhouette is DIAGNOSTIC only.

lanes.name: DENSE_FEATURES
lanes.notes: No learned backbone at pinned SHA. propose_dense_features is Canny/HOG. Searcher cheap descriptors are not dense features.

lanes.name: OCR
lanes.notes: Host tesseract via Searcher subprocess. Output is EXTRACTED, never OBSERVED.

lanes.name: LOGO_DETECTION
lanes.notes: No logo detector at pinned SHA.

lanes.name: LOCAL_CORRESPONDENCE
lanes.notes: No SIFT/SuperPoint/LoFTR. Product correspondence is a later wave.

lanes.name: MATERIAL_ANALYSIS
lanes.notes: Donor materials.* are renderer-parity kernels, not listing leather-vs-suede.

lanes.name: BROWSER_CAPTURE
lanes.notes: Browser capture requires the web extra; not used in this wave.

lanes.name: WORLD_STATE
lanes.notes: Donor world models are scene entities. Searcher owns ProductHypothesisGraph.

lanes.name: NEXT_VIEW
lanes.notes: Searcher-owned missing-evidence heuristic. Donor 3D next-view planner is deferred.

lanes.name: RECEIPT_VERIFY
lanes.notes: Searcher hash-chained receipts verify by recomputation. visionmcp.receipts.public is not imported (eager compiler/kernels).
